text:
Anna (Product): Quick sync — need a final decision on retention tiering + incident response for enterprise customers before we lock Q3 roadmap. BYOK interplay is the blocker.
Samir (Security): Agree. Two big constraints: legal-hold override and key escrow for evidence exports. If keys are fully customer-controlled, we need a documented escrow handoff for legal holds.
Tess (Solutions): FYI our finserv pilot asked for 7y retention + sub-day evidence export SLA. That blows storage and search costs.
Liam (Sales): +1 on the finserv ask — they will sign if we can guarantee retrievability and tamper-proof chain.
Maria (Legal): Legal hold must trump TTLs. We also need immutable audit trail and signed manifests for exported evidence. No escrow = no go for some customers.
Joel (SRE): Operationally we should do tiered storage: hot/warm/cold with different search SLAs. Example config mock:```retention:\n  hot: 30d\n  warm: 365d\n  cold: 3650d```Search SLA: hot=1s, warm=minutes, cold=hours.
Devon (Eng): If we add escrow, we need an HSM workflow + legal-auth steps. Also impacts canary and rollout — more manual steps.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: feature/retention-tiering -> staging (sha: abc123).
Samir (Security): Also: BYOK rotation rules. If customer rotates keys, we must ensure past exports remain decryptable. Suggest: escrow snapshot at time of export + signed key-wrapping metadata.
Tess (Solutions): Can we offer two SKUs: "Managed keys + extended retention (with search)" and "BYOK + archive-only retrieval (longer latency)"? That might cover both sides.
Anna (Product): That seems sensible. Need launch criteria: 1) legal sign-off on escrow, 2) SRE runbook for evidence export, 3) two pilot customers on both SKUs, 4) telemetry for cost delta.
Maria (Legal): I'll draft escrow contract language and the legal-hold override flow. Will share by EOD Thursday.
Joel (SRE): Runbook items: playbook for export, restoration test monthly, alerting for export failures, procedure for on-call escalation (pager if export fails >1h).
Devon (Eng): Estimated engineering scope: core retention tiers + key-escrow prototype + export pipeline: ~6w for MVP (1 eng + 1 infra + 0.5 legal/ops support). Canary rollout after infra test.
Liam (Sales): Put this in pricing appendix — customers will pay for managed search + retrieval. We need clear cost numbers.
Samir (Security): One more: SOC2 evidence sampling. We must be able to produce audit slices (signed logs) for SOC2 reviewers within 3 business days. Add to acceptance criteria.
Anna (Product): Action items: @Maria draft escrow/legal-hold; @Devon prototype escrow API; @Joel runbook skeleton + test plan; @Tess coordinate pilots; I'll update roadmap board and schedule triage meeting Friday 10am.
Tess (Solutions): I'll pull the pilot contracts and confirm retention windows.
Devon (Eng): I'll spike the key wrap/unwrap flow and post findings in this thread.
Samir (Security)::+1: please include threat models for escrow key custody.
Anna (Product): Thanks everyone — will capture notes and PRD after Friday triage. :thumbsup:
